load-failed: Error toast when a job's details panel could not be loaded.
run-failed: Error toast when one run's logs could not be loaded.
code-failed: Error toast when a version's code could not be loaded.
stopped: Toast after stopping a running job; {{name}} is its name.
stop-failed: Error toast when a running job could not be stopped.
restored: Toast after the job's approved code was stored again and the job started.
restore-failed: Error toast when the job's approved code could not be stored again.
delete-failed: Error toast when the job could not be deleted.
description: Under the job's name: {{command}} is how it runs (a shell command, not to translate); scratch is a dataset's name (not to translate); the granted forms count the other datasets it may use.
missing: Warning: the code of version {{version}} isn't in storage; the files form lists the missing files.
restore: Button that stores the approved code again and runs the job.
versions: Heading in a job's details panel over the list of its code versions.
version: A version number; v for version.
version-meta: After a version's date: {{timeout}} is its time limit (e.g. "300 sec"), {{files}} its files. The until-done form: the limit is per batch, and it runs until done.
code: Button that shows a version's code.
code-file: Heading over a file's code: its version and path.
runs: Heading in a job's details panel over the table of its past runs.
columns.started: Column heading: when the job's run started.
columns.trigger: Column heading: what started the run.
columns.status: Column heading: how the job's run went (a status badge).
columns.exit: Column heading: the run's exit code.
columns.took: Column heading: how long the run took.
trigger.manual: What started a run (by hand, the socio, or its schedule) and its version; the batch forms mark a batch of a long run.
trigger.dot: What started a run (by hand, the socio, or its schedule) and its version; the batch forms mark a batch of a long run.
trigger.schedule: What started a run (by hand, the socio, or its schedule) and its version; the batch forms mark a batch of a long run.
wake: After a run's duration: how long the computer took to wake up ({{duration}}).
logs: Button that shows a run's output.
run: Before a run's time, over its logs: "Run <time>: <status>".
stdout: Label of the standard output; a technical term, usually kept as is.
stderr: Label of the standard error output; a technical term, usually kept as is.
empty-output: Shown for an output with nothing in it.
delete: Destructive button at the bottom of a job's details panel that asks to delete the job.
confirm.title: Title of the confirmation dialog before a job is deleted.
confirm.body: Delete confirmation; {{name}} is the job's name. It leaves the person's and its socio's jobs.
progress.title: Heading of a long-running job's progress.
progress.stop: Button in a long-running job's progress box that stops the job.
progress.items: Row label: the long run's items, how many are done, left and failed.
progress.items-line: A long run's items: done, left, failed and in all; the working forms add those in progress, the so-far forms say more may be listed.
progress.batches: Row label: how many batches the long run has run so far, of the most it may run.
progress.batches-line: {{batches}} run of at most {{max}}; <time/> is when it started (a date and time).
progress.checkpoint: Row label: when the job last saved its place (a checkpoint) so the next batch can carry on from there.
progress.none: In the Last checkpoint row: the job hasn't saved a checkpoint yet.
progress.retries: Row label: retries of the current batch in a row.
progress.retries-line: {{retries}} is how many times in a row the current batch was tried again; {{max}} is the most allowed.
progress.next: Row label: when the next batch runs.
progress.waiting: Row label over why the run waits (the server's words).
progress.last-error: Row label over the last error the long run reported.
progress.outcome: Row label over a summary of how the long run ended (the server's words).
progress.set-aside: Heading over the items given up on, after one try or (retries form) several.
progress.set-aside-latest: The same, showing the latest {{shown}} of {{failed}} such items.
progress.item-failed: Stands in for an item's error when it has none.
progress.tries: An item given up on: its error and how many times it was tried.
confirm.delete: Destructive button in the confirmation that deletes the job.
